title: Backend Engineer
content: <p>We are hiring a <strong>Backend Engineer</strong> to join our payments team in Jakarta. Hybrid working (3 days in office).</p><h3>Requirements</h3><ul><li>3+ years of experience building REST APIs</li><li>Node.js and TypeScript</li><li>PostgreSQL</li><li>Docker</li></ul><h3>Nice to have</h3><ul><li>Kubernetes</li><li>Go</li></ul><p>Salary: IDR 18.000.000 - 25.000.000 per month</p>
